biggest_catch: Receipts pay about 5–20 coins — half a cent to ten cents each — and there's a 100-coin-per-week cap on paper receipts, so reaching the 1,000-coin ($5) minimum takes months.
catches: Coin value is roughly half a cent (1,000 coins = $5); a typical receipt earns 5–20 coins.
Paper-receipt earnings are capped at 100 coins per week; some receipts earn only sweepstakes entries, not coins.
Receipt Hog's own site says receipt data 'may be used in market research reports for the brands that purchase this data' — your shopping data is the product.
First cashout requires completing an intro survey and verifying your email/device.
Ticket stubs, credit-card slips, handwritten, and foreign receipts are ineligible.

steps: Install the Receipt Hog app (iOS/Android) and register free.
Snap a photo of any shopping receipt (in-store or online) in the app.
Earn coins per receipt (5–20 based on store type and total) plus Hog Slot spins.
Answer short purchase surveys for extra coins.
At 1,000 coins, redeem $5 via PayPal, Visa gift card, or Amazon gift card.
